CommunityApplications.Profile:
**My Cloud** — a lightweight, self-hosted file sharing platform in the spirit of Nextcloud/ownCloud, but with **zero database setup**. Multi-user accounts, a fast web file browser with previews and drag-and-drop uploads, public share links with passwords and expiry, a trash bin, and quotas — all stored as simple JSON files, with your files kept as plain files on the array.
Support is provided through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/evilgenius79/My-Cloud/issues).
